title: Your Neighbors Are Swingers
author: yourneighborsareswingers
description: A cheeky deep dive into the secret lives of your neighbors. In each episode of Your Neighbors Are Swingers, hosts Kate and Doug unpack the unexpected, hilarious, and often sexy secrets hiding behind picket fences and HOA rules. Kate and Doug share their stories and are entertained by guests from every corner of the lifestyle who join us to share theirs. Grab a drink, get comfy, and come discover what really happens when the curtains are drawn and the red lights are on.
